tasks.label: Validate TypeScript (Frontend)
tasks.command: cd app && npm run build 2>&1 | head -50
tasks.description: Enforces TypeScript strict mode on frontend code. Blocks edits if type errors exist.

tasks.label: Lint React Components
tasks.command: cd app && npm run lint -- --format json app/src/components 2>&1 | jq '.[] | select(.severity==2) | .message' | head -10
tasks.description: ESLint checks on React components. Warns on violations but allows edits.

tasks.label: Validate Python Async (Backend)
tasks.description: Basic Python syntax validation. Blocks edits on syntax errors.

tasks.label: Check Pydantic Models
tasks.command: cd codeaudit && python -c "from backend.models import *; print('✓ All models valid')"
tasks.description: Validates all Pydantic model definitions in models.py. Critical file.

tasks.label: Verify Path Aliases
tasks.description: Warns if relative imports found (use @/* instead). Non-blocking.

tasks.label: Session Events Valid JSON
tasks.description: Validates session event logs are well-formed JSON. Blocks corruption.

tasks.label: Config YAML Syntax
tasks.command: python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('$FILE')); print('✓ YAML valid')"
tasks.description: Validates config.yaml syntax. Blocks edits on parse errors.
